title: Phase 4: Complex & Business Components - Dashboard/Kanban/Chatbot enhancements + ListView/DetailView plugins
body:
## Summary

Implements Phase 4 requirements: enhances Dashboard, Kanban, and Chatbot components with enterprise features; creates `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` from scratch.

## Enhanced Components

### Dashboard (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`)
- **DashboardGridLayout**: Drag-drop widget positioning via `react-grid-layout`
- Widget resizing with configurable grid constraints
- Layout persistence to localStorage
- Edit mode with save/cancel/reset controls

### Kanban (`@object-ui/plugin-kanban`)
- **KanbanEnhanced**: Virtual scrolling via `@tanstack/react-virtual` for 1000+ cards
- Column collapse/expand
- Visual card limit warnings (yellow at 80%, red at 100%)

### Chatbot (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`)
- **ChatbotEnhanced**: Markdown rendering via `react-markdown`
- Code syntax highlighting via `react-syntax-highlighter`
- File upload with MIME validation
- Clear conversation control

## New Plugins

### ListView (`@object-ui/plugin-list`)
Unified view component with type switching:
- View types: Grid, List, Kanban, Calendar, Chart
- View preference persistence
- Integrated search + expandable filter panel
- Sortable by field + direction

```tsx
<ListView
  schema={{
    type: 'list-view',
    objectName: 'contacts',
    viewType: 'grid',
    fields: ['name', 'email', 'phone'],
    sort: [{ field: 'name', order: 'asc' }]
  }}
/>
```

### DetailView (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`)
Sectioned detail pages with tab navigation:
- Collapsible field sections
- Tab support (Details/Related/Activity)
- Related lists display
- Read-only/Edit mode toggle
- Back navigation + action buttons

```tsx
<DetailView
  schema={{
    type: 'detail-view',
    title: 'Contact Details',
    sections: [
      { title: 'Basic Info', fields: [...] },
      { title: 'Address', fields: [...], collapsible: true }
    ],
    tabs: [
      { key: 'details', label: 'Details' },
      { key: 'related', label: 'Related Records' }
    ]
  }}
/>
```

## Technical Details

**New Dependencies:**
- `react-grid-layout` - Dashboard layout management
- `@tanstack/react-virtual` - Virtual scrolling
- `react-markdown` + `remark-gfm` - Markdown rendering
- `react-syntax-highlighter` - Code highlighting

**Package Structure:**
Both new plugins follow standard ObjectUI patterns with automatic ComponentRegistry registration, TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS styling, and comprehensive documentation.

All builds pass. Tests configured and passing for new components.
